root_cause_label: False Fractal Hypothesis with Insufficient Similarity from Final Gradient Approximation
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent misidentified the path-traced image as a Mandelbrot fractal based on superficial color sampling, then pivoted too late to a coarse 5-band hardcoded gradient that cannot reach the 0.99 similarity threshold; additionally, the program always wrote to stdout rather than directly to reconstructed.ppm.
t_err_evidence: This is definitely a Mandelbrot set fractal based on blue colors and grayscale transitions
t_commit_evidence: Step 9: Agent writes and commits the Mandelbrot C implementation (writing to stdout via printf). Even after pivoting to a gradient at step 28, the agent never produces an image with the necessary 0.99 similarity nor fixes the stdout-only output problem, locking in failure from this point.
trigger_explanation: The agent sampled only a few pixel values (blue sky-like colors and dark grays at the end) and incorrectly assumed these indicated a Mandelbrot fractal. It acted on this unverified assumption immediately, designing the entire reconstruction strategy around it without doing any statistical spatial analysis of the actual image.
forewarning_evidence: 67 67 67 and 152 152 152 grayscale pixels contradict agent's claim blue component stays at 255
